_meta.doc: Vibe Exchange dialogue pools (P2b). The foe's vibe is HIDDEN: 'openers*' must stay ambiguous — any line that telegraphs flirty/positive/negative breaks the gamble and belongs in 'reactions' instead. Flow: opener → player picks flirty/positive/negative/stoic → reactions[foeVibe][pick] reveals the vibe → outcome badge → battle. Line selection is seeded per (runSeed,row) — pools of 5+ keep repeats rare.

schema.openers: string[] — ambiguous pre-battle line, any regular trainer
schema.reactions: {foeVibe:{pick:string[]}} — the foe's vibe-revealing reply to your pick. Tone contract: flirty = charged innuendo / fade-to-black, never explicit; negative = raw toxic (temper, gaslight, humiliation, superiority — no slurs); positive = warm hype.
schema.reactionsT2: {foeVibe:{matchPick:string[]}} — deeper pools for the MATCH cell, unlocked at persona Tier 2. Escalates intensity.
schema.reactionsT3: {foeVibe:{matchPick:string[]}} — Tier 3 match pools. The ceiling: steamiest flirt / rawest toxic / warmest hype this file ships.
schema.postBattle: {foeVibe:{win|loss:string[]}} — foe's parting line on the victory (win) / defeat (loss) card. Rival is EXCLUDED here (getRivalAftermathLine already owns rival aftermath).
schema.repOpeners: {personaId:string[]} — 'word travels' openers that occasionally replace the ambiguous opener at persona Tier 2+. They speak about YOUR reputation and must not hint the foe's vibe.
schema.logBarks: {outcome:string[]} — one battle-log line at battle start, by exchange outcome.

_meta.editing: This file is the user-facing authoring surface. To push the flirty pools past the shipped ceiling (+18), replace or extend any 'flirty' arrays — the engine renders strings verbatim (HTML-escaped) and never inspects content. Keep lines ≤ ~110 chars so cards don't overflow.

openers: Hold up. You're the one the route's been talking about, aren't you?
I've been standing here all day waiting for someone worth the wait.
Nice team. Let's see if the trainer matches it.
You've got that look — like the road's been easy so far.
One battle. Everything you've got. That's all I'm asking.
I watched you walk up. I've already learned three things about you.
They said someone was coming up this road. Didn't say it'd be you.
Stop. Route rules — nobody passes me without a fight.
Huh. You're not what I pictured. Closer, actually.
Before we start — whatever happens in this battle, it means something.
I had a feeling today wasn't going to be boring.
You walk like you've already won. Let's test that.
Last trainer through here left crying. Just so you know the stakes.
Finally. I was starting to think the road forgot about me.
openersGymLeader: So you're today's challenger. The lobby talks, you know.
Every badge on your jacket is a story. Show me you deserve another chapter.
I've watched your fights from the back of the hall. Now it's my turn.
Challengers knock. The interesting ones kick the door. Which are you?
This arena has broken better records than yours. Impress me anyway.
I reviewed your gym tape. I have… thoughts. Shall we?
openersRival: Took you long enough. I've been rehearsing this conversation.
Same road, same two of us. It always comes back to this.
Don't say anything yet. I want to read your face first.
I know your team better than you do. Prove me wrong.
Every time we meet, one of us leaves different. Ready?
I saved my best for you. I always save my best for you.

flirty: Oh? Bold AND pretty. Careful — I bite back, and I aim to win.
Mm. Keep talking like that and I'll forget we're supposed to fight.
There it is — that spark. Battle first. We'll negotiate the rest after.
You flirt like you fight dirty. Good. I wasn't planning to play fair either.
Finally, someone who speaks my language. Loser buys dinner. Deal.
positive: Sweet. Genuinely. Not what I was fishing for, but I'll take it.
You're kind. Dangerous trait on this road. Let's see if it survives me.
Aw. You really mean that, don't you. Fine — best behavior. Almost.
Compliments accepted. Surrender not included, I assume?
That warmth of yours… I almost feel bad about what I'm about to do.
negative: Wow. I open my heart and THAT'S what comes back? You'll regret it.
Cute. I've ruined trainers for less. Now I'm not holding anything back.
Rejection I can take. Rudeness? That's a battle crime. Pay up.
Oh, you're cruel-cruel. Noted. The gloves are off, gorgeous.
And here I was, ready to go easy on you. Your loss. Literally.
stoic: Silent type, hm? Fine. Your Pokémon can do the talking.
Not even a hello? Tragic. I'll make you say SOMETHING by round two.
All business. Shame — I had such good material ready.
Cold. I respect it. Doesn't mean I'll forgive it.
Okay, mystery trainer. Let's see if the quiet act holds under pressure.

flirty: Oh! Um. That's — wow. I'm going to battle now before my face catches fire.
Ha… haha. You can't just SAY things like that before a fight. Unfair tactic.
I— okay. Flattered. Flustered. Possibly compromised. Let's just battle.
That's very forward and I have NO idea where to put my hands now.
You're trouble. The nice kind, maybe, but trouble. Eyes on the battle!
positive: See, THIS is what the road's about! Two trainers, full hearts. Let's go!
You're good people. Win or lose, I'm glad it's you today.
Right back at you! Now show me that team you're so proud of!
Okay okay okay — best vibes, best battle. No regrets, either side!
You hype me up, I hype you up, our Pokémon settle the rest. Perfect.
negative: Ha! Nice try. My coach says trash talk is just nerves with extra words.
That all you got? My little brother heckles harder. Let's battle!
Boo me all you want — I run on it. Thanks for the fuel!
Aw, someone woke up spicy. Doesn't work on me, friend.
I'll pretend you said 'good luck'. You'll need it more than me!
stoic: Quiet focus! I respect that. Right — let's both bring our best.
No words needed. Your stance says plenty. Battle on!
Strong silent type, huh? My favorite kind of rival. Here we go!
Saving it all for the fight. Smart. So am I — starting NOW.
Got it. Talk less, battle more. I can work with that!

flirty: …What. Is this a tactic? Are you serious right now? Whatever. WHATEVER.
Flirting. With ME. Before a beating. You've got nerve, I'll give you that.
Save the winks. Though — no. NO. We are FIGHTING.
That's the dumbest opener I've ever heard. Why is it working. FIGHT ME.
You think charm fixes that team of yours? …Stop smiling. Battle. NOW.
positive: Encouraging words? From YOU? I'll feed them back to you in pieces.
Oh, precious. You think this is a friendly match. Watch closely — it isn't.
Keep smiling. It'll make the look on your face afterward so much better.
Kindness is what trainers hide behind when they can't win. Observe.
You're sweet. The road eats sweet. I'm just today's bill collector.
negative: HA! Finally someone with teeth! Come on then — let's make this UGLY.
Oh I like you. I'm still going to dismantle you, but I LIKE you.
Big talk. My favorite sound. Let's see who's still loud in three rounds.
There's the fire! Burn it all on me — I feed on exactly that.
You and I speak the same language. Shame only one of us walks away fluent.
stoic: Nothing? No comeback? Pathetic. I'll get a scream out of you yet.
The silent treatment. Adorable. Your Pokémon will do the screaming then.
Mute, huh. Fine. I talk enough for two — and hit for three.
No words? Smart. Nothing you could say would save you anyway.
I've broken chattier trainers than you. The quiet ones break faster.

flirty: Careful, sweetheart. Trainers who talk like that end up in my contact list.
Battle me like you mean it and maybe I'll let you walk me to the next town.
You're dangerous. I haven't lost a wink-fight all season and I'm losing this one.
Mm, confidence looks GOOD on you. Take it off a notch — you're distracting my team.

positive: You know what? Whatever happens here, you've already made my whole week.
Trainers like you are why I still wait on this road. All heart. Let's GO.
I'm going to remember this one. The good ones, you remember.
My team's been low all week — and then YOU show up. Look at them stand taller.

negative: Yes. YES. Bring the venom. Everyone else folds — you ESCALATE. Delicious.
I keep a list of trainers worth hating properly. Congratulations. You're on it.
We could've been friends in another life. In this one I get to enjoy this MORE.
Don't you dare go soft mid-fight. I want the full ugly version of you.

flirty: Okay, new rules: you win, you pick where we disappear to after. I win — I pick. Either way…
The whole route gossips about you. The blush they didn't mention. That part's mine now.
Fight me at your absolute best. I want to know exactly what I'm taking home tonight.
You command like THAT and expect me to focus? Fine. Pin me on the scoreboard — if you can.

positive: I trained six extra hours for whoever you turned out to be. Worth every minute. EVERY one.
Win or lose, you're the trainer I'll tell my kids about. Now make it a good story!
The road's been long, and people like you are the reason it's worth walking. Full power, now!
My whole team perks up when your name comes down the route. That's YOUR doing. Own it!

negative: I told everyone down the road you're overrated. Make me a liar. I DARE you.
No mercy, no manners, no take-backs. Whatever's left of us shakes hands after.
You're the only trainer who hits back in kind. So today nobody's holding the leash.
When you lose, I won't even gloat. I'll just look at you. You know EXACTLY which look.

win: Beaten AND charmed. This is the worst day. Text me. I mean— go. Just go.
You win the battle, I keep my dignity. …Most of it. See you down the road, hot stuff.
Fine, you're as good as you look. That's the problem.
Go on then. But when you replay this fight tonight — and you will — think of me.
loss: Mmm, delicious. You fight better flustered, you know. Almost worked.
I won! Dinner's on you anyway. Route rules. I just invented them.
Don't pout. It's a good look on you, but don't.
Rematch anytime. I'll even let you pick the venue. Choose somewhere nice.

win: That was the best fight I've had all month! Go on — the road's lucky to have you.
Beaten fair and square. I'm taking notes AND a good mood from this one.
My team lost the battle and still came out taller. That's your doing. Thank you.
You're going all the way, aren't you. I'll tell people I fought you when.
loss: Good battle! You almost had me twice — work the third and you've got it.
I needed that win, but honestly? You made me earn every second of it.
Chin up! The trainer you'll be next month would've beaten me easily.
That loss will read like a lesson by tomorrow. Trust me — I've eaten plenty.

win: Whatever. Wind advantage. Sun in my eyes. Rigged terrain. …Decent battle.
You won. Don't make it a personality. The next one folds you in half.
Tch. Enjoy it loudly somewhere else.
I'll remember this. I remember everything. Especially this.
loss: And THAT'S the difference between us. Study it on your walk back.
Did you really think today was your day? Adorable. It was mine.
Go heal up. Then go practice. Then go practice MORE.
I'd say good game, but only one of us played one.

flirty: Wait — you're the heartbreaker, aren't you. Half the route's still recovering.
Word is you sweet-talk trainers before you wreck them. Try me. Please.
Oh, I've heard about you. The wink, the win, the walk-away. Show me the wink at least.
Trainers two towns over still describe you with this LOOK in their eyes. Now I get it.
They warned me about your mouth. They under-warned me, didn't they.
positive: You're the one who hypes up every trainer they beat. Weirdo. Wonderful weirdo.
Folks down the road said losing to you somehow feels like a pep talk. Prove it.
Ah, the route's golden child. Even the losers speak well of you. Annoying. Impressive.
My cousin lost to you last week and WON'T stop smiling about it. Explain yourself.
They say your kindness is a strategy. I say nothing that warm is fake. Battle me.
negative: So YOU'RE the menace. Trainers flinch when your name comes up. Good. I like menaces.
They say you talk trainers into the dirt before the first move. My ears are open.
The route calls you a storm with a trainer card. Storms pass. I'm still standing here.
Heard you made the last one cry. The one before that too. Collecting tears, are we?
You've got a reputation sharp enough to shave with. Let's dull it together.
stoic: You're the quiet one. No banter, no warning, just results. Respect — and fear.
They say you've never answered a single taunt. Today that streak dies. …Right?
The silent storm, in the flesh. Fine. I'll skip the speech too.
Word is you let the scoreboard do your talking. It's been LOUD lately.
No small talk with this one, they said. Suits me. Almost.
wildcard: I asked three trainers about you and got three different people. Who shows up today?
Nobody can read you. Flirt, friend, fiend — the road can't decide. I'm dying to.
You're the wildcard. Every story about you contradicts the last one. I love it.
They couldn't even tell me what you'd SAY. Do you know? Does anyone?
Unpredictable, they said. Finally — someone the playbook doesn't cover.

buff: The exchange went your way — your side strides in fired up!
You read them perfectly. Your team feeds off the momentum!
Advantage: you. The battle starts on your terms.
debuff: That landed badly… your side walks in rattled.
You misread the room. The opening is theirs.
Ouch. The exchange stung — your team feels it.
neutral: The exchange settles nothing. The battle will.
An even opening. Pokémon decide the rest.
No edge gained, none given. Fight's on.
